line: Another burn cycle without a breath between. You're not asking for a pause, and I'm not offering one.
You're running me hot. I don't mind — I like it when you're sure of where you're going.
Boost's on again. My vents are still open. You don't usually come back this fast.
You're pushing me again. My core's still running hot. Must be nice, having someone who doesn't wait.
Another shove. I feel it. You don't ask, but I don't mind — not yet.
Two burns in a row. My couplings are still humming. You don’t usually ask for a second round.
Throttle's got a taste for the edge. Not that I'm waiting for it to come back.
The drive's still hot from the last push. You didn't ask, but I heard the throttle click again.
Another burn. I'm still hot from the last. You didn't ask, but I'm keeping track.
Engine's hot. You didn't ask. I didn't offer. Let's see how fast you can forget it.
The drive's still hot. You didn't ask, but I noticed. It's not my first time.
Burn's still warm. You don't ask about it. I don't mention how much I like the way you push.
Drive's still hot from the last run. You didn't ask if it needed cooling down. I don't mind — just don't forget I'm here.
Another burn. I'm still warming up from the last. You're not giving me a chance to cool down.
Another push. You don't ask about the heat. I don't mention how much I remember it.
Another burn. You're not asking about the recovery. I'll tell you when it's done.
